headline: PayPal presses on with turnaround in pivotal quarter as sale questions linger
summary: PayPal doubled down on its turnaround plan on Tuesday, raising its 2026 profit forecast and outlining cost-saving steps, as it looks to convince investors that it is worth more than the $53 billion takeover ‌offer that analysts described as "low-ball".  The payments company, once the crown jewel of American financial technology, received a $60.50-per-share bid from Stripe ‌and private equity firm Advent International, Reuters reported earlier this month, citing sources.  The offer is a fraction of the roughly $360 billion valuation PayPal commanded as a pandemic-era ​darling in 2021.
